title: Year of the Dog: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Known for their unwavering loyalty and fierce sense of justice, those born in the Year of the Dog are the protectors of the Chinese zodiac. Whether you were born in 1946, 1958, 1970, 1982, 1994, 2006, 2018, or look ahead to 2030, this sign brings profound integrity to every aspect of life. Discover what makes the Dog zodiac sign such a cherished and dependable companion in both work and romance.
personality: In traditional Chinese astrology, the Dog is synonymous with honesty, duty, and a deep-seated moral compass. People born under this sign possess a natural protective instinct, often stepping up as the steadfast defenders of the underdog or marginalized. They are profoundly empathetic and can sense insincerity from a mile away, making them incredibly selective yet fiercely devoted when choosing friends. While they may appear easygoing, Dogs hold themselves to impossibly high standards and carry a quiet resilience that sees them through major life storms. They prefer simplicity over superficial glamour, finding true joy in honest work, deep conversations, and a peaceful home environment. However, their vigilance can sometimes tip into worry, as they constantly scan the horizon for potential pitfalls to protect the people they love.
love: In matters of the heart, the Dog is cautious, devoted, and takes a long time to fully open up. Because they invest so deeply in relationships, they guard their hearts fiercely against betrayal. Once committed, a Dog partner offers unwavering loyalty and views love as a lifelong partnership built on mutual trust and shared values. They are practical romantics who show affection through acts of service, always ensuring their partner is safe, supported, and deeply cared for.
career: Dogs thrive in professions where they can champion justice, organization, and social good. They are exceptional team players who care far more about the success of a collective mission than personal glory. Ideal career paths for the Dog include law, social work, medicine, education, and counseling, where their strong ethical foundation can truly shine. As colleagues, they are dependable and meticulous, though they need autonomy to avoid feeling restricted by micromanagement.

faq.q: What years are associated with the Dog?
faq.ans: Recent Dog years include 1946, 1958, 1970, 1982, 1994, 2006, and 2018, with the next one arriving in 2030.

faq.q: What is the secret to a Dog's happiness?
faq.ans: Dogs find true happiness when they feel secure, valued, and surrounded by a harmonious, loyal circle of family and friends.

faq.q: Which signs are least compatible with the Dog?
faq.ans: Dogs typically face the greatest friction and communication challenges with the Dragon, Rooster, and Sheep.
